brief: Large showpiece gambrel barn about 40 ft wide and 80 ft long in barn-red drop siding with white corner boards and trim, a grey shingle gambrel roof crowned by two tall red cupolas with white-trimmed arched louvered belfries and steep grey pyramidal spire caps with finials. The gable end has a white-framed double hinged door, stacked white-cased windows and a small hay door; the long side has a neat row of small white-framed stall windows. A low grey-roofed red shed addition extends from the far end; barbed-wire fence and a big bare elm.
